question: A man spends 75% of his monthly salary on house rent. If every month, he also spends ₹653 on conveyance and ₹6,229 on grocery and saves the remaining ₹446, his monthly salary is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Remaining 25% of **salary** covers **conveyance**, **grocery**, and **savings**.

25% of **Salary** = ₹653 + ₹6,229 + ₹446 = ₹7,328

Total **Salary** (100%) = 4 × ₹7,328 = ₹29,312

**∴ The correct answer is ₹29,312.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/214d62f39ae92d1aac939afdb4d1fce2b2ab5c628dda41a709f5d05c392cd26c.png] 

Given **House Rent** = 75% of **Salary**

Given **Conveyance** = ₹653, **Grocery** = ₹6,229, **Savings** = ₹446

⇒ Let total **monthly salary** be S.

⇒ Total spending other than rent + Savings = 100% − 75% = 25% of S

⇒ 25% of S = 653 + 6229 + 446

⇒ (25/100) × S = 7328

⇒ S/4 = 7328

⇒ S = 7328 × 4

⇒ S = 29312

**∴ The correct answer is ₹29,312.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Expenditure

Total Salary is always considered 100%. If X% is spent, then (100 − X)% is the remaining amount which equals the sum of all other expenses and savings.

Successive Percentage

If the question mentions 'spending X% of the remaining amount', apply the formula: Remaining = Total × (100 − r₁)/100 × (100 − r₂)/100.

Basic Salary Formula

Income = Total Expenditure + Savings. All individual expense components must be summed to find total expenditure.
